list.title: Lɔlikɛlaw ni porozew
list.hint: Lɔlikɛlaw be don boon lɔbagaw ka dakun kɔnɔ walisa ka sɔn mɔgɔw ma u ka baara kama ani ka boon lɔli sɛgɛsɛgɛ.

detail.deactivateHint: Ka tagamasiɲɛw dabila, o b’a yira ko boon lɔbaga bɛɛ be bɔ yen joona joona.
detail.resetPrompt: Kunnafoni kura {{name}} kama (a ka dɔgɔ ni sɛbɛnin 8 ye). U bena tagamasiɲɛw kɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ.
detail.projectsHint: Jɛnɲɔgɔnw be porozew sugandi porozew la minw be kɛra tuma min na u be ɲɛminɛbaga dɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛra; o cikan be taga o lɔbaga fɛ.
detail.closeReferrals: A datugu mɔgɔ minw be taga n’u ye
detail.back: Kɔsegi ka taga boon lɔbagaw fɛ
